iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing
How do I file a claim? Claim filing details are not released yet. Clarkson Law Firm said on its
website
that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."
According to the court filing, the website "will include all necessary information to learn about the settlement" and a number consumers can call with questions. Edited by
Aimee  Picchi
The Associated  Press
contributed to this report.

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布將於今年稍後以測試版形式推出全新升級的 Siri AI，該助理將使用 Google Gemini 系列模型，能在應用程式間取得上下文、提升語音辨識與資訊檢索，並與 Apple Intelligence 深度整合。  

- Apple 表示 Siri AI 會在 iOS 內部直接抓取使用者的應用程式資訊，例如「從簡訊中取得妹妹推薦的播客名稱」並直接呈現，而不必另開其他 App 或服務【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Siri AI 的核心模型來自 Google 的 Gemini 系列（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Flash、Pro 以及影像模型），但 Apple 強調不使用 Google 向消費者提供的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 新版 Siri 將聚焦於語音口述功能，並在 Safari、密碼與訊息等應用中加入 Apple Intelligence 的 AI 功能，提升個人化上下文安全性與第三方 App 自動化【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 同時，分析師指出 iPhone 銷售在過去四個季度已成長 16%，為 Siri AI 的推出提供了強勁的硬體基礎【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

總結來說，Apple 在 WWDC 上的主要新訊息是：Siri 進入 AI 時代，透過 Google Gemini 模型與自家 Apple Intelligence 進行深度結合，將於今年稍後以測試版上線，並預計提升語音助理的上下文理解與跨 App 自動化能力。

records.query: 最近分析師對 Apple 股票有哪些利多的看法？
records.answer:
Apple 股票的利多觀點主要集中在 **服務收入提價、iPhone 17 強勁需求、AI 功能升級以及超強的現金流與高利潤率** 上。[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]、[AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]、[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]、[AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0] 均有相關說明。

**具體利多因素**  

1. **服務價格提升顯示定價權**：Apple 正在提升服務價格，證明其在生態系統內具備定價能力【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  

2. **iPhone 17 週期帶來兩位數增長**：iPhone 17 週期的出貨量增長約 23%，推動整體營收上升【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  

3. **AI 整合與 Siri 重大升級**：公司將在 WWDC 上展示重新設計的 Siri，利用 AI 提升個人化與第三方應用自動化，預計可與 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等競爭【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

4. **服務業務持續高增長**：分析師預期服務收入年增率將超過 14%，支撐毛利率突破 48%【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  

5. **現金流與自由現金流極為強勁**：TTM 自由現金流達 $129.2 billion，足以覆蓋 $7.7 billion 的股息與 $37.0 billion 的回購，顯示資金回饋能力極佳【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

6. **毛利與營業利潤率領先同行**：TTM 毛利率 47.9%（較 FY2024 的 46.2% 上升），營業利潤率 32.6%，EBITDA 利潤率 35.4%，均高於大多數同業【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

7. **三年平均營收增長仍保持正向**：過去三年平均營收年增率為 5.6%，雖非高速成長，但在科技硬體領域屬於穩定的複合增長【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  

8. **市場對 Apple 的高估值反映其品牌與服務護城河**：前瞻 P/E 為 33.5 倍，遠高於大多數硬體同業，投資者願意為其服務組合與品牌溢價付出更高估值【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。

- **AI Cloud 合約**：雙方簽署的 **$3.4 billion** 合約針對空冷 Blackwell GPU，首批部署將在 Childress 站點的 **60 MW** 空冷容量內完成，並預計在 2026 年底前支援 **150,000** 台 GPU，目標在 2026 年底達成 **$3.7 billion** 的年度經常性收入（ARR）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

- **財務影響**：受此合作推動，IREN 的 AI Cloud 服務收入在本季升至 **$33.6 million**（較前季 **$17.3 million**），而比特幣挖礦收入則下降至 **$111.2 million**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

總結來說，NVIDIA 與 IREN 的最新合作結合了巨額資金承諾、長期 AI Cloud 合約以及大規模 GPU 部署計畫，旨在將 IREN 的電力資產快速轉化為 AI 計算能力，並在 2026‑2027 年間大幅提升雙方的收入與市場佈局。

Chief Executive Tianyi Jiang outlined the company’s strategy around Microsoft 365, multi-cloud data protection and artificial intelligence governance during a D.A. Davidson discussion hosted by analyst Rudy Kessinger. Jiang said AvePoint, founded in 2001, began in the Microsoft SharePoint ecosystem with products for data backup, archiving, migration and governance. He described the company as “the largest Microsoft Office Cloud ecosystem player” in unified SaaS data integration, backup, archiving and governance, while noting that its customer base has expanded beyond regulated industries into small and medium-sized businesses. “We often got those commentaries like we’re the best company people never heard of,” Jiang said. AI Push Raises Focus on Data Governance
Jiang said the rise of generative AI has increased enterprise attention on data quality, access control and lifecycle management. He said companies need to curate proprietary and unstructured data across emails, shared drives, Box, Dropbox and CRM systems before AI tools can deliver useful outputs. He said AvePoint positions itself between the data and model layers of AI infrastructure, helping enterprises manage their data estate, access controls and retention policies. Jiang added that the shift toward AI agents is increasing concerns around “shadow AI,” AI-related risk and token-based cost management. “Every CFO has to worry about consumption-based, token-based budgeting,” Jiang said. “That means there’s a lot more intentionality towards responsible and cost-effective AI deployment.”
Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary

[MSFT] Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary
Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. records.query: 新聞報導 Apple 為什麼被視為值得長期持有的股票？
records.answer:
Apple 被視為值得長期持有的股票，主要是因為它擁有極強的現金產生能力、堅固的資產負債表以及持續成長的高毛利服務業務，這些因素共同提供了穩定的回報與防禦性。[AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]

- **現金與資本回報**：Apple 在過去 12 個月產生了 **$140.2 billion** 的營運現金，並有 **$129.2 billion** 的自由現金流，足以覆蓋 **$7.7 billion** 的股息與 **$37.0 billion** 的回購，顯示現金流遠超資本支出需求。[AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]  
- **資產負債表**：公司持有 **$146.6 billion** 的現金與有價證券，僅有 **$82.7 billion** 的長期債務，淨現金位置正向且持續增長，屬於「堡壘級」資產負債表。[AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]  
- **盈利能力**：TTM 毛利率達 **47.9%**（較 FY2024 的 46.2% 上升），營業利率 **32.6%**，EBITDA 利率 **35.4%**，自由現金流利率 **22.4%**，所有指標均領先同業。[AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]  
- **服務與生態系統**：服務佔比提升帶動毛利提升，且 Apple 能在服務上提升價格，顯示其在生態系統內具備定價權；服務收入正以雙位數增長，預期未來多年可持續升級與貨幣化。[AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]、[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1]  
- **裝置基礎與用戶黏著**：全球超過 **2.5 billion** 台設備的安裝基礎，iPhone 最近四季增長 **16%**，顯示產品需求仍然強勁，為服務收入提供持續的用戶基礎。[AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]、[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]  
- **AI 與未來增長**：Apple 正在整合 AI（如重新設計的 Siri）以提升數位助理功能，預期將進一步推動設備與服務的互動，增強長期競爭力。[AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0]  
- **資本配置與股東回報**：公司持續執行大規模回購與穩定股息，且資本配置保持紀律，為投資者提供「可見的回報底線」並支撐其作為核心長期持股的定位。[AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]、[AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1]  
- **市場評價與風險**：儘管面臨監管挑戰（如 DOJ 訴訟與 EU DMA），分析師仍認為服務收入 >14% 的增長與毛利 >48% 能支撐其溢價估值，並將 Apple 列為「最佳永續持有」的標的之一。[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]  

綜合以上，Apple 以其強大的現金流、健康的資產負債表、高毛利率、持續增長的服務業務、龐大的裝置生態系統以及前瞻的 AI 投資，為投資者提供了穩定且具防禦性的長期回報，因而被視為值得長期持有的股票。

The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

records.answer:
NVIDIA 目前的毛利率在提供的資料中沒有具體披露；至於黃仁勳最近表示中國市場將逐步開放高階 AI 晶片銷售，若最終允許這些產品進入，預計會為公司未來營收帶來新增的增長動能。  

- **毛利率資訊缺乏**：在所有引用的新聞稿與報導（如《China market for Nvidia AI chips to open ‘over time’》）中，未見任何關於 NVIDIA 當前毛利率的數值或百分比說明【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。因此，根據現有材料，無法提供具體的毛利率數據。  

- **中國市場開放的最新談話**：  
  - 黃仁勳在接受 Bloomberg 訪問時指出，「中國市場將會逐步開放」高階美國 AI 晶片，並提到 H200 晶片已取得對華授權但尚未見到實際採購【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
  - 他補充說「我的感覺是，隨著時間推移，市場會開放」並強調 Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被禁止在中國銷售【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  
  - 同時，相關報導提到 NVIDIA 的財報即將於本週公佈，投資人正關注此類政策變化對營收的潛在影響【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #0】。  

- **對未來營收的潛在影響**：  
  - 若中國最終放寬對 H200 以及未來 Blackwell、Rubin 系列的限制，這將為 NVIDIA 打開一個龐大的 AI 晶片需求市場，因中國是全球最大的 AI 應用與算力需求國之一。  
  - 目前仍未有中國客戶實際購買 H200 的跡象，且中國正加速自研晶片以挑戰美國主導地位，這意味著即使市場開放，短期內的營收貢獻仍可能受限。  
  - 另一方面，黃仁勳的樂觀表態暗示公司已做好供應與授權的準備，若政策放寬，相關收入有望在中長期內顯著提升。  

總結來說，根據現有資料，我們無法提供 NVIDIA 的具體毛利率數字；而黃仁勳對中國市場逐步開放的表態，若最終轉化為實際銷售，將可能成為公司未來營收的新增增長點，但仍需觀察中國本土晶片競爭與政策落實的進度。

records.query: Apple 目前的毛利率表現如何？加上新聞中 Evercore ISI 最新調升的目標價與評等，市場如何綜合看待這家公司？
records.answer:
Apple 目前的TTM毛利率為 **47.9 %**，較 FY 2024 的 46.2 % 以及 FY 2019 的 38.2 % 都有明顯提升【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

Evercore ISI 最近將 Apple 的目標股價從 **$330** 上調至 **$365**，同時維持 **Outperform** 評等【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  

市場對 Apple 的綜合看法如下：

* **估值溢價**：Apple 的 forward P/E 為 33.5 倍，遠高於同業（如 Dell 22.2 倍），而 price‑to‑cash‑flow 為 30.7 倍，顯示投資人為其服務收入與品牌護城河支付溢價【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
* **營收成長**：TTM 營收為 **$451.4 billion**，年增率 12.8 %（自 FY 2021 以來最快），但相較於 SNDK（82.8 %）與 WDC（32.0 %）仍屬較慢；三年 CAGR 為 5.4 %【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
* **獲利能力**：毛利率 47.9 % 只落後 SNDK（56.0 %），EBITDA margin 為 35.4 %，levered FCF margin 為 22.4 %，ROE 高達 141.5 %【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
* **看漲因素**：分析師預期服務收入年增率可超過 14 %，毛利率有望突破 48 %，這將支撐其高估值【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  
* **看跌因素**：美國司法部訴訟與歐盟《數位市場法》可能迫使 App Store 佣金模式調整，對主要利潤來源構成風險，並可能導致 P/E 大幅下修【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  
* **整體情緒**：市場情緒被描述為「中性」，投資者在高服務毛利與監管風險之間權衡，仍對 Apple 的長期現金生成與品牌優勢保持信心【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  

因此，Apple 目前的毛利率表現強勁且持續上升，市場在肯定其高現金流與服務增長的同時，也對監管挑戰保持謹慎，整體評價偏向中性但帶有溢價。

) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,

. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. **關於黃仁勳最新對中國市場開放 AI 晶片銷售的談話，透露的競爭定位要點如下：**  

1. **長期市場開放預期** – 黃仁勳在接受 Bloomberg 采訪時表示，「中國市場會隨著時間逐步開放」高端美國 AI 晶片的銷售，暗示未來中國需求有望恢復，為 NVIDIA 的 AI 硬體提供新的增長機會【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

2. **當前仍受限制** – 目前最先進的 Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被禁止在中國銷售，且 H200 晶片雖已獲得「許可」但仍未見中國客戶實際採購，說明短期內 NVIDIA 仍受政策壁壘限制【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  

3. **競爭加劇** – 同時，NVIDIA 正面臨來自 Cerebras、AMD 以及其大客戶 Amazon（AMZN）和 Google（GOOGL）自研 AI 晶片的激烈競爭。Cerebras 最近 IPO 並宣稱其處理器在整體性能上更快；AMD 即將推出競爭性的機架式伺服器系統；Amazon 的 AI 晶片業務已達年收入超過 200 億美元且呈三位數增長【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

4. **市場情緒與風險** – 黃仁勳的中國行程與美國總統同訪，顯示公司正積極與政策層面互動，然而美國立法者仍警告放寬限制可能助長中國軍事用途，這為 NVIDIA 的中國業務帶來政策不確定性【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  

**綜合判斷**：黃仁勳的表態顯示 NVIDIA 把中國視為長期增長潛力，但同時承認當前受限與競爭者的挑戰。公司在全球 AI 晶片領域仍保持領先地位（因其產品被稱為「世界最有價值的公司」），但必須在政策限制與日益增多的競爭者壓力下，持續維持技術與市場優勢。

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於它打造的全端 加速計算平台——從自家 GPU、CPU、DPU 硬體，到 CUDA、Tensor Core、AI Enterprise 等軟體堆疊，並透過龐大的開發者與合作夥伴生態系統，使其在 AI、資料中心與圖形運算等多個千億美元市場保持領先。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  

**技術與產品層面的護城河**  
- **GPU 與 Tensor Core 硬體**：自 2017 年推出首款 Tensor Core GPU 以來，NVIDIA 持續在 GPU 架構中嵌入 AI 專屬功能，最新的 Blackwell 系列更結合了「神經圖形」與新一代 DLSS 變壓器模型，提升遊戲與本地 AI 工作負載的效能。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]；[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]  
- **資料中心級別的 AI 計算**：Blackwell 架構支撐「數十億」GPU 互聯，形成單一巨型電腦，並與 Grace CPU、DPUs（來自 2020 年收購 Mellanox）共同提供完整的資料中心算力平台。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]；[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]  
- **完整軟體堆疊**：CUDA 開發平台自 2006 年起讓 GPU 可被廣泛應用於科學計算與 AI；NVIDIA AI Enterprise 包含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等工具，提供端到端的生成式 AI 應用開發與部署環境。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]  
- **專屬 AI 模型與推理軟體**：Nemotron（代理式 AI）與 Cosmos（實體 AI）等開放模型平台，加速了客戶在自家硬體上部署大規模模型的速度與成本效益。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]  

**生態系統與市場佈局**  
- **開發者基礎**：全球已有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他 NVIDIA 軟體工具，形成強大的生態圈，提升平台黏著度與網路效應。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]  
- **產業滲透**：平台支援從遊戲、專業視覺化、醫療、汽車自駕到大型雲端服務供應商的多元垂直市場，所有這些市場均以相同的底層可編程架構為基礎，形成跨產業的規模經濟。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  
- **合作夥伴與服務**：NVIDIA 的 AI 超級電腦、雲端服務供應商（CSP）以及自家 AI 超級電腦皆可使用其完整堆疊，並透過 Inception 計畫與數萬家新創企業、數百所大學的合作，持續擴大技術採用率。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]  

**研發與長期投資**  
- **研發投入**：公司自創立以來已累計投入超過 767 億美元於研發，確保在 GPU、AI 演算法與系統整合方面保持領先。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  

綜合以上，NVIDIA 的護城河由硬體創新（GPU、Tensor Core、Grace CPU、DPU）、軟體平台（CUDA、AI Enterprise、開放模型）、龐大且活躍的開發者與合作夥伴生態，以及跨多個千億美元產業的深度滲透共同構成。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過同一套可程式化的底層架構（GPU、CPU、CUDA、互連與軟體堆疊），同時在資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場提供加速運算平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。  

**核心做法**  
- **統一硬體與軟體基礎**：NVIDIA 以 GPU 為核心，結合自家 CPU、NVLink/InfiniBand 互連、CUDA 開發平台以及各式 API、SDK 與領域‑specific 軟體庫，形成「全堆疊」平台，讓同一套晶片與軟體可在不同應用場景中重複使用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **可程式化架構**：其可程式化的 GPU 架構允許在同一硬體上部署多種工作負載，從高效能資料中心運算到即時遊戲渲染皆能共享基礎技術【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。  

**四大市場的具體佈局**  

1. **資料中心 (Compute & Networking)**  
   - 以加速 AI、資料處理、圖形與科學運算的「Data Center」平台為主，提供包括 GPU、CPU、NVLink 互連、完整的軟體堆疊（加速函式庫、模型、API）在內的整體解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  
   - 2026 年推出的 NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 讓客戶能將自訂 CPU 與 XPU 與平台深度整合，進一步提升資料中心規模與效能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  

2. **遊戲 (Graphics)**  
   - 透過 GeForce RTX 系列 GPU、DLSS 深度學習超取樣技術與即時光線追蹤 (RTX) 讓 PC 與筆電遊戲獲得更高畫質與幀率，所有功能皆建構在同一套 CUDA 與 Tensor Core 架構上【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  
   - Blackwell 架構在 2025/2026 年推出，加入「神經圖形」與新一代 DLSS，進一步將 AI 與傳統渲染結合，仍使用相同底層硬體與軟體平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

3. **專業視覺化 (Professional Visualization)**  
   - RTX PRO GPU 為專業工作站提供加速，透過與 ISV 合作的軟體優化（如 3D 設計、工程與內容創作應用）使用相同的 Tensor Core 與 CUDA 堆疊，讓 AI 功能直接嵌入專業工作流程【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

4. **車用 (Automotive)**  
   - DRIVE Hyperion 平台結合高效能 DRIVE AGX 硬體、車載作業系統 (DRIVE OS)、感測器套件與模組化軟體平台，全部基於同樣的 GPU、CUDA 與 AI 加速器，提供從雲端到車端的完整自動駕駛解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

透過上述「全堆疊」與「可程式化」的底層架構，NVIDIA 能在四大市場共享研發投入、軟體生態與硬體互連技術，實現規模經濟與跨領域加速效益【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 產品組合，讓它成為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 訂閱服務的一部分，並以 AI‑enabled 功能、工具與「agentic」情境貫穿 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams、Security & Compliance 等核心模組，藉此推動座位數與訂閱收入成長【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

- 在 2025 年的財報中，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入指標已明確將 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 列入計算範圍，並以「Microsoft 365 Commercial subscriptions, comprising … Microsoft 365 Copilot」來定義其雲端營收【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- 這一整合策略被描述為「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」；Microsoft 365 的成長依賴於「在核心產品與服務中加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 情境」來提升通信、協作、分析、安全與合規等多個 AI 商務生產力領域的價值【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 同時，Copilot 也被定位為「digital companion」在 Microsoft Edge 與 Bing 搜尋中提供使用者體驗，進一步支援 Microsoft 365 生態系的使用者獲取與黏著度【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57】。  

因此，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 訂閱的核心 AI 元件，並在財務指標與產品路線圖中同步追蹤其貢獻，來實現產品策略的 AI 化與收入增長。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 通过 Windows OEM 许可和自有设备（如 Surface）把大量终端用户带入其云平台和 Copilot 服务，从而提升云端和 AI‑Copilot 的使用率。  

- Windows OEM 和 Devices 的收入被合并为单一增长指标，显示公司把 Windows 授权与设备销售视为推动云业务的核心入口 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142]。  
- 在业务叙述中，微软明确指出“利用 Windows 来为我们的云业务提供燃料，增长 PC 市场份额，并推动 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer 等服务的更高参与度” [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。  
- Windows 的商业版（Windows Commercial）被计入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 云收入，且该收入包括 “Windows Commercial 的云部分”，与 Microsoft 365 Copilot 等 AI‑驱动功能共同构成云服务收入的组成部分 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。  
- 通过 Windows 平台的多租户和统一安全框架，微软能够在其云基础设施上提供更低成本的计算、存储和网络资源，这进一步降低了客户采用 Azure 与 Copilot 的门槛 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。  

因此，Windows 既是终端入口，又通过 OEM 许可、设备生态和与云服务的深度集成，帮助微软扩大云端用户基数并提升 Copilot 等 AI 服务的渗透率。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在透過大幅提升技術與基礎設施支出，同時以可轉換票據與非投票優先股等方式向 Anthropic 等 AI 企業投入數十億美元，來加速 AWS 雲端基礎設施與人工智慧（AI）領域的佈局【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。

**投資策略要點**  

1. **持續擴大 AWS 相關基礎設施**  
   - Amazon 把資金投入於伺服器、網路設備、資料中心折舊與攤銷等基礎設施，並將這些成本依使用情形分配至各事業部門【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】。  
   - 2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年上升，主要來自基礎設施支出（包括折舊與攤銷）以及外匯因素造成的 $312 million 增加【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】。  
   - 2026 年第一季（Q1 2026）相較於去年同期，技術與基礎設施成本再次上升，外匯因素貢獻 $374 million【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  

2. **聚焦 AI 與機器學習研發**  
   - 公司的支出計畫明確包括支援人工智慧與機器學習的基礎設施與員工增聘，預期未來支出將持續增加【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
   - 這些投資同時支援 AWS 內部的 AI 服務與外部客戶的 AI 應用，提升平台的競爭力與客戶體驗【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  

3. **策略性投資 Anthropic**  
   - 在 2025 年第三季，Amazon 將部分可轉換票據投資於 Anthropic 轉換為非投票優先股，產生 $2.3 billion 的可供出售債券利得【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #33】。  
   - 2025 年至 2026 年間，Amazon 持有的 Anthropic 非投票優先股市值從約 $14.8 billion（截至 2025‑12‑31）增至 $32.0 billion（截至 2026‑03‑31）【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
   - Amazon 已於 2026 年第一季投資 $5.0 billion 購買 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並與 Anthropic 簽訂一項最高 $20.0 billion 的融資設施，該設施在 Anthropic 完成特定運算容量交付後可供其提取，提取方式包括發行新可轉換票據或在公開上市後以普通股形式兌換【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
   - 此外，Amazon 擁有額外最高 $5.0 billion 的投資選項，可在未來的股權融資中進一步增持 Anthropic，若行使此選項將相應減少上述 $20.0 billion 設施的可用金額【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

4. **其他長期技術投資**

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在其電商平台（包括線上商店、物流履約網路與 Prime 服務）以及雲端服務 AWS 上，都面臨政府與監管機構的反壟斷與競爭相關調查，且這些調查可能導致高額罰款、合規成本上升，甚至限制業務成長【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】。

- **電商與 Prime 相關風險**：美國及其他司法管轄區的監管機構正審查 Amazon 的商店運營、履約網路以及 Prime 會員服務，指稱其可能違反競爭法或消費者保護規定【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。若調查結果不利，Amazon 可能被迫改變營運方式、支付巨額罰金或承擔民事／刑事責任【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】。

- **AWS 雲端服務風險**：同樣的競爭與反壟斷調查亦波及 AWS，監管機構質疑其雲端服務的市場行為是否構成不公平競爭【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。此類調查可能導致 AWS 必須調整定價、產品捆綁或客戶條款，並面臨潛在罰款【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】。

- **資料隱私與「門檻」規範**：Amazon 亦受到日益嚴格的資料收集、使用與披露規範的審查，監管機構對其隱私實務的解讀仍在演變，增加了合規不確定性與成本【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。此外，因被視為「線上門檻」企業，Amazon 可能受到新法規的額外限制，進一步提升合規負擔【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】。

- **中國與印度的特定監管挑戰**：在中國與印度，當地法律對外國投資、互聯網、資料中心、零售與物流等領域設定許可與所有權限制，Amazon 必須透過與持有本地牌照的第三方合作來提供服務，這些結構雖符合現行法規，但仍面臨監管變動的風險，可能影響其在這兩大市場的業務運營【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #93】【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #87】。

- **整體影響**：上述調查與監管壓力若轉化為正式執法行動，將可能導致「實質成本增加、民事或刑事罰金、需求或服務可得性下降、聲譽受損、成長受阻」等多方面不利結果【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 正在把 Gemini AI 直接嵌入搜尋、YouTube、Google Workspace、Google Cloud 以及多項消費者服務，讓這些產品都能即時使用其多模態、推理與生成能力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **搜尋（Google Search）**：Gemini 3 以「先進的多模態理解」和「增強推理」支援 Search 的 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，讓使用者可以用自然語言提出更複雜的問題，系統會在搜尋結果頁面即時產生回應與互動式體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **YouTube 及其他消費者產品**：所有 15 個「半億用戶」的產品（包括 YouTube）已經使用 Gemini 模型，這意味著在 YouTube 影片說明、推薦與搜尋等功能中，Gemini 會提供生成式內容與更精準的相關性判斷【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **Google Workspace（企業協作套件）**：Gemini for Google Workspace 把 AI 助手嵌入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，協助使用者撰寫、組織、視覺化與加速工作流程【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **Google Cloud 服務**：透過 Gemini Enterprise，企業客戶可以在自家環境或雲端上部署 Gemini 代理人，將 AI 能力帶入內部流程與應用程式；同時，Google Cloud Platform 也提供 AI‑optimized 基礎設施（TPU、GPU）來訓練與服務 Gemini 模型【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **消費者訂閱與 Google One**：Google One 訂閱服務現在提供存取最先進的 Gemini 模型，讓個人用戶也能在日常使用中受惠於高階生成式 AI【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155】。  

總結來說，Google 透過搜尋介面的 AI Overviews/Mode、YouTube 內容生成、Workspace 智能助理、Cloud 的企業 AI 平台以及 Google One 訂閱，將 Gemini AI 全面化地嵌入其核心產品與服務生態系，實現「AI‑驅動的多模態體驗」在所有主要使用者觸點的即時可用【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices

Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices revenues consist of revenues from:

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋在 2025 年透過加入 **AI Overviews** 與 **AI Mode** 兩項功能，從單純的關鍵字搜尋演變成讓使用者可以直接以自然語言提問，並即時得到生成式 AI 回答的多模態體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

- **AI Overviews** 讓使用者只要輸入「問 Google 任何事」的簡短指令，就能得到一段綜合性、可直接使用的回應，降低了需要多次搜尋才能獲得完整資訊的門檻【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Mode** 則允許使用者提出更為細緻、具多層次的問題，這些問題在過去可能需要多次搜尋或手動整合資訊才能解答；AI Mode 以 Gemini 系列的先進推理與多模態能力（包括文字、影像等）直接在搜尋結果頁面提供答案【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- 這兩項功能皆建構於 **Gemini 3** 這套最新的生成式 AI 模型之上，Gemini 3 具備更強的推理與生成能力，並已被整合至 Google 所有 15 個「半億」使用者的產品中，包括 Search、YouTube 以及 Workspace 等【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在 10‑K 中，Alphabet 表示，隨著 AI 產品（如 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode）逐步嵌入搜尋與其他服務，未來的營收與毛利率可能會因「先以使用者體驗為先、後期再考慮變現」的策略而出現不同於傳統廣告的增長與利潤走勢【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。  
- 此外，Google 仍將 AI 視為「平台性轉變」的核心，透過自有的 AI‑optimized 基礎設施（TPU、GPU）與全端研發，持續在搜尋、雲端與其他產品中擴散 Gemini 的能力，以因應生成式 AI 對搜尋市場的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #127】。  

總結來說，Google 搜尋藉由 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 兩項生成式 AI 功能，將傳統關鍵字搜尋升級為自然語言、具多模態理解與即時生成答案的服務，並以 Gemini 系列模型與自有硬體基礎設施支撐，形成對生成式 AI 衝擊的主動回應與長期競爭優勢。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是透過 AI、可穿戴裝置與虛擬／增強實境，打造下一代的計算平台與元宇宙生態系統【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。

- **願景與策略**：自 2021 年起，Meta 轉型聚焦於「將元宇宙帶入生活」的策略，將研發重點放在 AI、可穿戴裝置與新型介面上，以建構下一代的計算平台【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。  
- **投資規模與分配**：Meta 將持續在 Reality Labs 大幅投資，預計 2026 年約 70% 的 Reality Labs 營運費用將用於可穿戴事業，剩餘 30% 用於 VR 與 Horizon 相關項目【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **產品與技術路線**：  
  - **VR**：Meta Quest 系列裝置與 Meta Horizon Store 內容平台，並加入「passthrough」技術讓使用者在虛擬與現實間切換【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
  - **可穿戴與 AR**：AI 眼鏡（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）內建 Meta AI 對話助理；2024 年推出的 Orion 原型是真正的 AR 眼鏡；2025 年推出的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 結合鏡片內嵌顯示與 Meta Neural Band（利用肌電訊號控制眼鏡）【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
  - **AI 模型**：持續加大 AI 模型的開發與訓練投入，預計未來仍會提升相關投資【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  
- **財務影響**：Reality Labs 的巨額投資已使 2025 年整體營運利潤下降約 191.9 億美元，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  
- **風險提示**：Meta 亦指出，若 Reality Labs 的策略與投資未能成功，可能對公司品牌、使用者基礎、營收與整體財務表現產生不利影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。  

綜合以上，Meta 正以 AI、可穿戴與 VR/AR 為核心，長期投入資源於 Reality Labs，目標是構建支撐元宇宙的下一代計算平台，同時接受相關財務與市場風險。

In addition, as our Reality Labs efforts evolve, we may be subject to a variety of existing or new laws and regulations in the United States and international jurisdictions, including in the areas of privacy, safety, AI, competition, content regulation, medical devices, tariffs, export controls, consumer protection, and e-commerce, which may delay or impede the development of our products and services, increase our operating costs, require significant management time and attention, or otherwise harm our business. 20


As a result of these or other factors, our Reality Labs strategy and investments may not be successful in the foreseeable future, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brands, our ability to maintain or expand our base of users, marketers, and developers may be impaired, and our business and financial results may be harmed.

[META 10-K period 2025] All of these investments are part of our long-term initiative to help build the next computing platform. In 2026, we expect to spend approximately 70% of our Reality Labs operating expenses on our wearables initiatives, and the remaining 30% on our VR and Horizon initiatives. We apply significant judgment in estimating this expense breakdown as there are certain shared costs across product lines, and our expectations are subject to change, including as the next computing platform and our business strategies evolve.

[META 10-K period 2025] In the near term, we are continuing to develop products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced passthrough capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AI glasses and long-term AR initiatives. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

[META 10-K period 2025] develop and train our AI models, and expect to continue to increase these investments. We are also continuing to increase our investments in new platforms and technologies, including as part of our VR, Horizon, and wearables efforts. Some of these investments, particularly our significant investments in Reality Labs, have generated only limited revenue and reduced our operating margin and profitability, and we expect the adverse financial impact of such investments to continue for the foreseeable future. records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要靠在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等應用上以「展示次數」或「使用者行動」收費的廣告來創造營收，同時利用 Meta AI 來提升廣告投放、內容排序與使用者體驗，讓廣告更具效率與相關性【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。

**廣告獲利模式**  
- 廣告收入幾乎佔全部營收，廣告主根據 **廣告展示次數 (impressions)** 或 **使用者點擊、購買等具體行動 (actions)** 付費【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- 公司將「每則廣告的平均價格」定義為「總廣告收入除以交付的廣告次數」，此指標反映每位廣告主實際支付的單價【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）廣告收入較 2025 年同季增加 **133 億美元，成長 33%**，主要因 **廣告展示次數提升 19%** 以及 **平均每則廣告價格上升 12%**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
- 廣告收入的增長同時受 **外匯匯率有利影響**，以及 **線上商務垂直領域的貢獻**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  

**Meta AI 在 App 中的角色**  
- Meta AI 是一個跨平台的 AI 助手，內嵌於 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、WhatsApp、Threads 以及 AI 眼鏡等產品，協助使用者「學習、完成任務、創作內容」並促進連結【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- AI 技術被用於 **內容排序 (content ranking)**、**推薦引擎 (discovery engine)**、以及 **廣告工具**，提升廣告的投放精準度與測量能力【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在 2025‑2026 期間，Meta 持續投入 **生成式 AI** 與 **隱私增強技術**，以在減少個人資料處理的同時，提升廣告的相關性與測量效果，並開發讓廣告主能將自有資料匯入 Meta 系統的工具【META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #208】。  
- 這些 AI 驅動的改進被視為 **提升廣告表現、提升每則廣告的平均價格** 的關鍵因素，並在 2026 年第一季促成平均價格上升 12%【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過以展示次數與使用者行動為基礎的廣告收費模式獲利，並藉由 Meta AI 在各應用內提供內容排序、廣告目標化與生成式工具，提升廣告的效能與收入。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-Q period 202509] We are engaging with regulators on our consent model. In addition, mobile operating system and browser providers, such as Apple and Google, have implemented product changes and/or announced plans to limit the ability of websites and application developers to collect and use these signals to target and measure advertising. For example, in 2021, Apple made certain changes to its products and data use policies in connection with changes to its iOS operating system that reduce our and other iOS developers' ability to target and measure advertising, which has negatively impacted, and we expect will continue to negatively impact, the size of the budgets marketers are willing to commit to us and other advertising platforms. To mitigate these developments, we are continually working to evolve our advertising systems to improve the performance of our ad products. We are developing privacy enhancing technologies to deliver relevant ads and measurement capabilities while reducing the amount of personal information we process, including by relying more on anonymized or aggregated third-party data. In addition, we are developing tools that enable marketers to share their data into our systems, as well as ad products that generate more valuable signals within our apps. More broadly, we also continue to innovate our advertising tools to help marketers prepare campaigns and connect with consumers, including developing growing formats such as Reels ads and our business messaging ad products. Across all of these efforts, we are making significant investments in artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI, to improve our delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities. Further, we are focused on driving onsite conversions in our business messaging ad products by developing new features and scaling existing features. We are also engaging with others across our industry to explore the possibility of new open standards for the private and secure processing of data for advertising purposes. We believe our ongoing improvements to ad targeting and measurement are continuing to drive improved results for advertisers. However, we expect that some of these efforts will be long-term initiatives, and that the legislative, regulatory and platform developments described above will continue to adversely impact our advertising revenue for the foreseeable future. In addition, we maintain advertising policies to protect the security and integrity of our platform and comply with global content, security, and integrity obligations. Our ongoing efforts to enhance enforcement against ads and marketers which violate our advertising policies adversely affect our revenue, and we expect that the continued enhancement of such efforts will have an impact on our revenue in the future, which may be material. Other Business and Macroeconomic Conditions

Other global and regional business, macroeconomic, and geopolitical conditions also have had, and we believe will continue to have, an impact on our user growth and engagement and advertising revenue. In particular, we believe advertising budgets have been pressured from time to time by factors such as inflation, economic policies and international trade, high interest rates, and related market uncertainty, which has led to reduced marketer spending. We are currently subject to increased business, macroeconomic, and geopolitical uncertainty, including as a result of volatility around international trade, which could impact our financial results in future periods.

[META 10-Q period 202603] Advertising

Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, ad impressions delivered increased by 19%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 5% in the same period in 2025. Ad impressions delivered during the three months ended March 31, 2026 grew in all regions, especially in Asia-Pacific, which was driven by increases in users and their engagement as well as the frequency of ads shown on our products. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the average price per ad increased by 12%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 10% in the same period in 2025. The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact. This increase was partially offset by a higher number of ad impressions delivered, especially in geographies and in products, such as Reels, that monetize at lower rates. Other factors are discussed in the section entitled "—Executive Overview of First Quarter Results." In addition, the online commerce vertical was the largest contributor to the increase in advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. We anticipate that future advertising revenue will be driven by a combination of price and ad impressions delivered. Other revenue

FoA other revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $375 million, or 74%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was mostly driven by paid messaging from WhatsApp and Meta Verified subscriptions. Reality Labs

RL revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 decreased $10 million, or 2%, compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was driven by lower Meta Quest sales, offset by an increase in sales of AI glasses. Foreign Exchange Impact on Revenue

Changes in foreign exchange rates had a favorable impact on our revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. To calculate revenue on a constant currency basis, we translated revenue using the prior year's monthly exchange rates for our settlement or billing currencies other than the U.S.

[META] It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc. has a collaboration with Microsoft Corporation, NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Broadcom Inc., and OpenAI, L.L.C. The company was formerly known as Facebook, Inc. and changed its name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

[META 10-K period 2025] 70


Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把全自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是把 AI‑驅動的自動駕駛功能直接嵌入所有車型，並以垂直整合、以安全與使用者體驗為核心的營運模式來凸顯優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。

- **AI 與產品結合**：公司明確表示「我們專注於將人工智慧帶入現實世界，透過全自動駕駛（FSD）(Supervised) 與 Robotaxi 等產品與服務」來實現這一目標【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。  
- **安全與性能**：在產品設計上「強調性能、吸引人的造型與使用者與員工的安全」，並持續「開發全自動駕駛技術以提升安全」【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。  
- **垂直整合與使用者體驗**：Tesla 強調「工程專長、真實世界 AI 的進步、垂直整合的商業模式，以及對使用者體驗的聚焦」是讓其與其他公司區隔的關鍵因素【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。  
- **未來服務藍圖**：除了已上市的 FSD（監督式）外，還在規劃 Robotaxi 服務，顯示自動駕駛不僅是功能，更是未來營收與生態系的核心【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。  

綜合上述，Tesla 透過將 AI‑驅動的全自動駕駛功能深度整合於其電動車平台，並以安全、垂直整合與卓越使用者體驗為差異化主張，來在市場上與其他汽車與科技公司區隔開來【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #152】。

On March 22, 2023, the plaintiffs filed a motion for a preliminary injunction alleging that Tesla made certain statements regarding the capabilities of Full Self-Driving Capability and seeking various forms of injunction relief, and on September 30, 2023, the Court denied the plaintiffs’ motion, compelled four of five plaintiffs to arbitration, and dismissed the claims of the fifth plaintiff with leave to amend the complaint. On May 6, 2025, the plaintiff filed a motion for class certification, which Tesla opposed, and on August 18, 2025, the Court certified a limited class comprised of California consumers who are not subject to an arbitration agreement. On September 1, 2025, Tesla filed a petition in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for permission to appeal the class certification order, and on December 18, 2025, the Ninth Circuit granted Tesla’s petition. On January 5, 2026, the district court stayed the case pending resolution of the proceedings before the Ninth Circuit. The appeal has been fully briefed by the parties, and oral argument is set for August 31, 2026.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「傳統內燃機車廠」與「新興電動車廠」雙重且日益激烈的競爭，且競爭範圍遍及整個車型細分、市場供應鏈、技術與人才等多個層面【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。

- **車型細分市場的直接對手**：Cybertruck 必須與其他皮卡競爭；Model S 與 Model X 主要與高階轎車與豪華 SUV 競爭；Model 3 與 Model Y 則在小型至中型轎車與緊湊 SUV 市場與眾多競爭者爭奪市場份額【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。  
- **傳統與新興製造商的壓力**：除了既有的大型汽車公司仍以內燃機車為主的產品外，許多傳統與新興車廠已推出或計畫推出電動、混合動力及插電式混合動力車型，導致整體競爭環境更加「高度競爭」【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62】、【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- **電池供應鏈的限制**：Tesla 目前僅與極少數合格供應商合作，供應鏈彈性受限；若電池芯供應中斷或原料（鋰、鎳等）價格波動，將可能迫使 Tesla 必須以更高成本採購或削減產量，進一步削弱其在市場上的競爭力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62】。  
- **自動駕駛與 AI 競爭**：在自動駕駛（Robotaxi）與人工智慧領域，Tesla 必須與傳統叫車服務、其他自動駕駛開發商以及廣義的 AI、機器人公司競爭，這些競爭者在資源、研發與成本效率上可能具備更優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51】、【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
- **能源產生與儲存業務的競爭**：Tesla 的能源儲存與發電系統亦面臨來自大型公用事業公司與其他太陽能、儲能廠商的價格與技術競爭，若對手提供更低價格或更易切換的方案，可能削弱 Tesla 產品的吸引力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51】。  
- **人才爭奪**：因為電動車、AI 與自動駕駛等領域需要高度專業的工程與技術人才，Tesla 在全球範圍內與其他汽車與科技公司爭奪同樣稀缺的人才，若無法吸引或留住關鍵人才，亦會影響其競爭表現【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #78】。  

綜合以上，Tesla 在電動車市場的競爭態勢是：**多元車型市場的直接對手、供應鏈與原料成本的外部壓力、快速增長的自動駕駛與能源業務競爭，以及全球人才市場的激烈爭奪**，這些因素共同構成了高度且持續升溫的競爭環境。
contexts: [TSLA 10-K period 2025] We believe that our vehicles compete in the market based on both their traditional segment classification as well as their propulsion technology. For example, Cybertruck competes with other pickup trucks, Model S and Model X compete primarily with premium sedans and premium SUVs and Model 3 and Model Y compete with small to medium-sized sedans and compact SUVs, all of which are extremely competitive markets. Competing products typically include internal combustion vehicles from more established automobile manufacturers; however, many established and new automobile manufacturers have entered or have announced plans to enter the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles. Overall, we believe these announcements and vehicle introductions promote the development of the electric vehicle market by highlighting the attractiveness of electric vehicles relative to internal combustion vehicles. Many major automobile manufacturers have electric vehicles available today in major markets including the U.S., China and Europe, and other current and prospective automobile manufacturers are also developing electric vehicles. In addition, several manufacturers offer hybrid vehicles, including plug-in versions.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. As part of our business, we seek to protect the underlying intellectual property rights of these innovations and designs such as with respect to patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, confidential information and other measures, including through employee and third-party nondisclosure agreements and other contractual arrangements. For example, we place a high priority on obtaining patents to provide the broadest and strongest possible protection to enable our freedom to operate our innovations and designs across all of our products and technologies as well as to protect and defend our product portfolio. We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] If the uptake rate for autonomous driving solutions does not develop as we expect, our business, prospects, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. We face strong competition for our products and services from a growing list of established and new competitors. The worldwide automotive market is highly competitive today and we expect it will become even more so in the future. A significant and growing number of established and new automobile manufacturers, as well as other companies, have entered, or are reported to have plans to enter, the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles, including hybrid, plug-in hybrid and fully electric vehicles, as well as the market for self-driving technology and services and other vehicle applications and software platforms. In addition, certain government and economic incentives which provide benefits to manufacturers who assemble domestically or have local suppliers, may provide a greater benefit to our competitors, which could negatively impact our profitability. Many of our competitors have significantly more or better-established resources than we do to devote to the design, development, manufacturing, distribution, promotion, sale and support of their products and services, and may achieve additional cost efficiencies owing to location and economic environments. Increased competition could result in our lower vehicle unit sales, price reductions, revenue shortfalls, loss of customers and loss of market share, which may harm our business, financial condition and operating results. We also face competition in our energy generation and storage business from other manufacturers, developers, installers and service providers of competing energy technologies, as well as from large utilities. In addition, decreases in the retail or wholesale prices of electricity from utilities or other renewable energy sources could make our products less attractive to customers and lead to an increased rate of customer defaults. Growth of our business is also dependent upon our ability to develop and commercialize Bots, including Optimus, which is in a nascent industry that has yet to develop commercially. 15


We currently are developing Bots, including Optimus, and intend for these products, as well as accompanying services, to be an important part of our business going forward. While this development requires significant cash investments and management resources, there is no guarantee this business will be successful. We have yet to commercialize Bots and cannot predict how demand for Bots will develop, either from commercial or consumer applications. We also face significant competition from other companies that are designing, developing and building robotics applications. Our success will depend on various factors, including our ability to successfully apply our artificial neural network training experience to autonomous robots, to either source or custom develop the necessary technology and components, and the product’s cost-effectiveness, utility and competitive positioning relative to market alternatives. If our Bots program fails to develop as we expect, or progresses more slowly than expected, our business, prospects, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. Risks Related to Our Operations

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] If we are not successful in managing these risks, our business, financial condition and operating results may be harmed. Employees may leave Tesla or choose other employers over Tesla due to various factors, such as a very competitive labor market for talented individuals with automotive or technology, including AI, experience, or any negative publicity related to us. In regions where we have or will have operations, particularly significant engineering and manufacturing centers, there is strong competition for individuals with skillsets needed for our business, including specialized knowledge of electric vehicles, engineering and electrical and building construction expertise.

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務定位為公司長期成長的核心支柱，與電動車事業相互補強，並透過先進電池、AI 軟體與模組化設計推動營收多元化與成本優化。 [TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]

- **策略性定位**：公司將能源生成與儲能產品（如 Powerwall、Megapack、Solar Roof）視為「差異化且有效率管理的產品組合」的一部分，藉此在全球推動清潔能源，同時降低客戶取得成本、提升產品標準化與可及性。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]  
- **競爭優勢**：Tesla 強調其能源儲存系統的高能量密度、效率與模組化特性，加上強勢品牌與可擴展設計，使其在價格、能量密度與性能上相較於既有與新興競爭者具備優勢。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]  
- **技術與平台整合**：能源儲存產品利用來自車輛的電池與電力電子技術，並結合 AI 驅動的軟體平台（Powerhub、Autobidder）進行遠端控制與最佳化，提升系統的靈活性與價值。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  
- **產品擴張與新產品**：2025 年開始量產新型住宅翻新太陽能板，並於 2026 年初交付首批客戶，同時持續製造與改進 Solar Roof，以提升美觀與耐用度，並與 Powerwall 完全整合。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  
- **基礎建設與投資**：為支撐能源業務，Tesla 正在擴建 AI 訓練叢集（Cortex 2）與製造產線，並投入額外的計算硬體與半導體合作，以加速 AI 推論與訓練，進一步提升能源系統的智慧化與自動化。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32]  
- **營運成果**：2025 年公司部署了 **46.7 GWh** 的能源儲存產品，顯示該業務已成為實質的收入與容量貢獻來源。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115]  
- **長期成長與盈利**：在 2025 年的年度報告中，Tesla 明確將能源生成與儲能列為「差異化且有效率管理的產品組合」之一，作為推動「盈利成長」與「全球基礎設施」擴張（包括服務與充電網路）的關鍵驅動力。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115]  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能不僅是 Tesla 的多元化收入來源，更是利用其電池與 AI 核心技術、提升品牌競爭力、支撐未來自動駕駛與 Robotaxi 服務的戰略平台。

Servicing the vehicles ourselves allows us to identify problems and implement solutions and improvements faster than traditional automobile manufacturers and their dealer networks. [TSLA 10-K period 2025] In order to enable a greater supply of cells for our products with higher energy density at lower costs, we have developed a new proprietary lithium-ion battery cell and improved manufacturing processes. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

We leverage many of the component-level technologies from our vehicles in our energy storage products. By taking a modular approach to the design of battery systems, we can optimize manufacturing capacity of our energy storage products. Additionally, our expertise in power electronics enables our battery systems to interconnect with electricity grids while providing fast-acting systems for power injection and absorption. records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中承認，儘管它設計並自行開發硬體、作業系統與軟體，但在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置市場只佔「少數」市場份額，且面臨來自資源豐厚、價格 aggressive、產品線廣泛的競爭者的強烈壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  

- **市場佔有率**：文件明確指出 Apple 在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置市場皆為「少數」市場佔有者【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **競爭者特徵**：競爭者擁有「顯著的技術、行銷、分銷與其他資源」以及「已建立的硬體、軟體與服務產品」與龐大客戶基礎【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **競爭手段**：許多對手透過「激進的價格競爭、降低產品毛利率」以及「模仿 Apple 的產品功能與應用」來爭奪市場【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】；部分競爭者甚至能以「極低或虧損的價格」提供產品【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **價格與毛利壓力**：Apple 自己指出，市場「價格競爭激烈、毛利率向下壓」且消費者與企業對價格高度敏感【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #3】。  
- **產品生命週期與創新速度**：市場特徵包括「新產品快速推出、產品生命週期短、行業標準快速演變」以及「競爭者迅速採用新技術」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #3】。  
- **供應鏈限制**：Apple 亦提到其許多關鍵元件依賴單一或有限供應商，若供應中斷會加劇競爭壓力，因競爭者可能利用更廣泛的供應來源取得成本優勢【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **第三方開發者影響**：由於 Apple 在上述市場的佔有率較低，第三方開發者可能較不願投入資源於 Apple 平台，進一步削弱其產品吸引力與競爭力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

綜合以上，Apple 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中將自己描述為在智慧型手機、PC、平板等核心市場僅佔少數份額，且必須持續應對資金充裕、價格激進、快速模仿與供應鏈限制等多重競爭壓力。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過龐大的活躍裝置基數、高毛利服務收入以及完整的硬體‑軟體整合平台，讓開發者在 iOS 生態系中能夠獲得可觀的營收與使用者觸及，從而提升相較於 Android、Windows 等競爭平台的黏著度【1†AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

- **市場規模與收入機會**：Apple 的 iPhone 佔總營收 51%，單季 iPhone 營收達 $57.0 billion，服務部門佔總營收 28%，單季服務收入創下 $31.0 billion 的高毛利紀錄，且全年營收 TTM 為 $451.4 billion，年增 12.8%【3†AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。如此規模為開發者提供了龐大的付費用戶基礎（約十億活躍裝置）和高價值的訂閱與應用銷售渠道【3†AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。

- **平台與工具**：Apple 透過 App Store、Apple Pay、Apple Card、iCloud、Apple Music、Apple TV+、Apple Arcade、Apple Fitness+ 等多元服務，為開發者提供應用分發、廣告、支付與雲端儲存等完整生態，讓開發者的產品能在硬體、軟體與服務間無縫互動【4†AAPL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **高毛利與廣告收入**：Apple 的廣告服務與自有廣告平台亦為開發者帶來額外收入來源，進一步提升平台吸引力【5†AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #20】。

- **開發者黏著度的決定因素**：公司指出，開發者是否願意投入資源取決於「相較於競爭平台（如 Android、Windows）之預期營收、未來產品銷售成長與開發成本」等因素；Apple 透過其市場地位、龐大用戶基數與高毛利服務，提升了開發者對平台的感知利益【1†AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

- **挑戰與風險**：Apple 亦承認在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率相對較低，可能使部分開發者更傾向於資源投入 Android 或 Windows 等市佔較高的平台，這是 Apple 必須持續透過創新與服務增值來克服的挑戰【1†AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

綜合以上，Apple 以龐大的活躍裝置基數、顯著的服務營收、完整的應用與支付平台，以及高毛利結構，為第三方開發者提供了比 Android、Windows 更具吸引力的收入與成長機會，從而建立了較高的開發者黏著度，同時也持續面對市場佔有率帶來的潛在風險【2†AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #104】。

Apple needs no introduction, but the company’s transformation does. What was once a hardware story is now a hybrid: $80.2 billion in product sales last quarter alongside $31.0 billion in high-margin services. The installed base of active devices hit another all-time high across every product category and every geography. Apple sells iPhones, Macs, iPads, wearables, and a growing suite of subscription services to roughly a billion paying users globally. Apple segments its business into the following areas:
iPhone (51% of total revenues)

Services (28% of total revenues)
– App Store, advertising, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and payment services
Mac (8% of total revenues)
– Laptops and desktops, including the newly launched MacBook Neo
Wearables, Home & Accessories (7% of total revenues)
– AirPods, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and accessories
iPad (6% of total revenues)
– Tablet lineup, recently refreshed with the M4-powered iPad Air
iPhone revenue jumped 22% to $57.0 billion, the standout of the quarter. Services climbed 16% to a record $31.0 billion, propelled by advertising, App Store, and cloud. Greater China rebounded sharply, with renminbi strength adding fuel. Tim Cook called demand for the iPhone 17 lineup “extraordinary.”
On the strategic front, Apple is going all-in on AI infrastructure. R&D spending jumped 34% year-over-year to $11.4 billion last quarter, citing higher infrastructure costs. Tariff overhang remains real but manageable. A February Supreme Court ruling struck down certain tariffs, and Apple is applying for refunds. The company also flagged that semiconductor, NAND, and DRAM supply constraints could pressure costs into the next quarter. Story Continues

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）錄得 **$13.192 億** 的營收，與去年同期的 $13.371 億 基本持平，僅微幅下降 1%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #46】。  

- **Windows 與 Devices**：Windows OEM 收入增長 2%（因 OEM 庫存提升），但 Devices 部分營收下降，使得 Windows & Devices 總體僅略微下降 2%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】；此增長與設備下滑相互抵消。  
- **Gaming**：Xbox 硬體營收大幅下滑 31%，內容與服務營收下降 3%（受去年強勁第一方內容基數影響），整體 Gaming 營收下降約 6%（約 $1.1 億）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  
- **Search Advertising**：搜尋廣告營收則上升 10%（約 $1.0 億）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】（在另一段落中亦提到上升 9% 約 $304 百萬），此增長在一定程度上抵消了 Gaming 的下滑。  
- **Xbox Game Pass**：雖未列出具體金額，但內容與服務營收的下降被 Game Pass 的增長部分抵消【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  

因此，More Personal Computing 的營收基本持平，主要是 **Windows OEM 成長抵消 Devices 下降、Search Advertising 成長抵消 Gaming 下降**，形成互相抵銷的效果。

records.query: Amazon AWS 部門最新一季營業利益成長的主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon AWS 部門在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的 Q1）營業利益之所以顯著提升，主要是 **銷售額的增長**，即客戶使用量上升所帶來的收入提升，同時也因為 **為支撐這波增長而加大的技術與基礎建設投資** 以及 **匯率變動的負面影響** 而被部分抵消。  

- AWS 營業利益從 2025 年 Q1 的 **$11.547 billion** 增至 2026 年 Q1 的 **$14.161 billion**，增幅約 **$2.614 billion**（約 22.7%）【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 增長的主要驅動力是 **銷售額上升**，2026 年 Q1 AWS 銷售較去年同期增長 **28%**，反映客戶使用量提升【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】。  
- 同期 **技術與基礎建設支出** 亦同步上升，因為公司為支撐 AWS 業務的快速成長而投入更多資本，這部分支出在一定程度上抵消了營業利益的提升【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 另外，**匯率變動** 對 AWS 營業利益產生 **$339 million** 的負面影響，進一步說明匯率因素削減了部分收益【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  

綜合以上，AWS 營業利益的成長核心在於銷售額的大幅提升，伴隨的技術基礎建設投入與匯率不利影響則分別提供了正向與負向的調整。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 以 **$29.5 billion** 完成了對雲端安全平台 Wiz 的收購，並將其財務結果納入 Google Cloud 部門的合併報表中【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。

- 收購價格為 $29.5 billion，分配後的主要項目包括 **$8.3 billion 的無形資產**、 **$22.705 billion 的商譽**，以及 **($1.538 billion) 的淨負債**（此金額從購買價中扣除）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- 這筆投資是 Google Cloud 為加速其在多雲與 AI 驅動的安全能力而作出的戰略布局，收購完成後，Wiz 的營運結果會在 Google Cloud 部門內呈現【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。  
- 商譽已被記錄在 Google Cloud 部門，主要歸因於預期的協同效應，且不具稅務可扣除性【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- 因此，Wiz 的收購直接提升了 Google Cloud 的資產基礎（無形資產與商譽），並預期透過安全技術的加強，提升該部門的市場競爭力與收入貢獻【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。

Overview

Our Company and Our Businesses

NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. Since our original focus on PC graphics, we have expanded to several other large and important computationally intensive fields. Fueled by the sustained demand for exceptional 3D graphics and the scale of the gaming market, NVIDIA has leveraged its GPU architecture to create platforms for scientific computing, AI, data science, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and digital twin applications. NVIDIA is now a data center-scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries. Our two operating segments are “Compute & Networking” and “Graphics.” Refer to Note 13 of the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements in Part I, Item 1 of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for additional information.
